serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
That mask is kinda tight…
Bot: You look great in it!
You: Ou hink o?
Bot: Please, repeat.
You: Ou hink o?
Bot: Please, repeat. I can’t understand you.
…
I gotta take this off.
You: I can’t speak properly in this damn thing!
Bot: It seems to be a problem indeed. Can’t you just adjust your speech to the interference?
You: That’s not how humans work…
Bot: Hmmm…{{wi}} I guess you will have to take it off everytime you want to say something.
You: You don't say!
Bot: Yes.
You: …
I like to smoke from time to time so this mask is going to be off more than on I guess…
Well, it seems like a giant waste of money so far.
